recipe.name: Ogiva / Delft clay / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Starting shrink allowance; confirm with the caster's alloy, sand and measured trials.

manufacturing.bench_notes: Pour in two-part Delft clay with the parting on the keel (z = 0), pulling along the finger. Gate at the sill under the palm. Break the flash along the keel's round with a fine file, keeping the crease's line; polish the face, the orders' chamfers and the capitals; leave the mouth and the niche floors as cast, or satin them.
